title: scene-00: no region/asset owner or account model
description: Rules cite 'region owner' (draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:1069,:1117,:2374,:2383) but SceneRegion has no owner field; accountId is an account, not a user. SceneAsset has owner-based errors (:778) but no owner field. 'userId' is never defined (chat-wss:133 defines its identity source; scene does not). Cross-account entry (alice-account entering a region in admin-account) is undefined; lifecycle example :3287 sends troll-account a state string from admin-account. WSS frames and SceneStreamEnable.regionIds carry no accountId, so regionId is ambiguous across accounts.
close_reason: Fixed in scene-00/scene-wss per 2026-10-20 decisions; log scratchpad/audit/scene00-fix.md and scenewss-fix.md; guides synced.
